title: Amazon S3 to Amazon SQS
description: Sends notifications from S3 to SQS when an object is created.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This creates an S3 bucket and SQS queue. S3 writes a messages to the SQS queue when a new object is put into the bucket.

bullets.text: Building resilient serverless patterns by combining messaging services
Choosing between messaging services for serverless applications

text: See the GitHub repo for detailed deployment instructions.

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Upload an object to the S3 bucket created by the deployment: aws s3 cp 'test_upload.txt' s3://
2. In the console, check the SQS queue created by the deployment for new messages containing the S3 event.
3. You can also use the SQS CLI to fetch new messages from the queue: aws sqs receive-message --queue-url QUEUE_URL --max-number-of-messages 10.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 3. Confirm the stack has been deleted: terraform show.
